# AceLib

AceLib is a Folia-first shared foundation library for Paper and Folia plugins, providing safe scheduling, thread-context checks, configuration, messaging, commands, events, data, player state, world operations, GUI, items, external integrations, Bedrock support, forms, and diagnostics.

## Library overview
- [AceLib README](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, JitPack installation, plugin.yml setup, and API acquisition via ServicesManager.
- [AceLib README (zh-TW)](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/README.zh-TW.md): Same overview in Traditional Chinese, with installation and lifecycle instructions.
- [Documentation Index](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/README.md): Start here to find the right guide for your task — consumer, operator, contributor, or reference.

## Consumer
- [Consumer Overview](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/consumer/README.md): Where downstream plugins start — how to get the provider API and where to read next.
- [Quick Start](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/consumer/quickstart.md): Complete Gradle setup, plugin.yml declaration, and provider retrieval for first-time integration.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/consumer/compatibility.md): Supported baseline for AceLib 1.2.0 (Java 25 / Paper 26.1.2 / Folia 26.1.2), per-build VERIFIED-BETA for 26.2, UNVERIFIED for unknown future versions, plus Bedrock dependencies and limitations.
- [Provider Lifecycle](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/consumer/provider-lifecycle.md): How to handle AceLib ready, reload, and disable states by re-acquiring the provider API.

## Operator
- [Operator Guide](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/operator/README.md): Build the server JAR from source, deploy it to Paper or Folia, and verify startup with `acelib status`.

## Contributor
- [Contributor Guide](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/contributor/README.md): Development setup, test commands, documentation checks, and local Maven publishing.

## Modules
- [Modules Overview](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/README.md): Index of all subsystem modules and their service entry points.
- [Core API](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/core.md): Acquire version, platform, and services from a ready AceLibApi instance.
- [Safe Scheduling](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/scheduler.md): Folia-safe scheduling for global, async, player, entity, and location tasks.
- [Thread Context Safety](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/context.md): Check and dispatch work to the correct thread or region via SafeExecutor and ContextInspector.
- [Platform Capability](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/platform.md): Detect Paper versus Folia and branch logic via Platform and PlatformCapability.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/config.md): Manage YAML config schemas, defaults, reload, and versioned migrations with ConfigManager.
- [Message Service](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/message.md): Localized chat, action bar, title, and broadcast messaging via LangManager and MessageService.
- [Command Model](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/command.md): Describe commands and subcommands with CommandSpec, SubCommandSpec, and ReplySink abstractions.
- [Event Registry](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/event.md): Region-aware Bukkit event registration with SafeEventRegistry and ListenerPolicy.
- [Data Store](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/data.md): Persistent data interface with schema migrations, async submission, and lifecycle control via DataStore.
- [Player Data and Session](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/player.md): Load, track, and persist player sessions and dirty records with PlayerDataService.
- [World Operations](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/world.md): Safe block, entity, and teleport operations using immutable LocationSnapshot and EntityReference.
- [GUI](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/gui.md): Open and manage protected inventory GUIs with generation-checked sessions and async updates.
- [Custom Items](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/item.md): Create, identify, serialize, and migrate custom ItemStacks with AceItemFactory.
- [Bedrock Players](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/bedrock.md): Detect Bedrock players via Floodgate and query device, input, language, and link state.
- [Forms](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/form.md): Send Bedrock native forms via FormSpec DSL and receive responses with region-redispatched callbacks.
- [External Integrations](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/external.md): Probe Vault, PlaceholderAPI, LuckPerms, and Floodgate availability via ExternalIntegrationService.
- [Diagnostics](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/modules/diagnostics.md): Collect module states, error throttling, and diagnostic reports via acelib status and DiagnosticsService.

## Reference
- [Error Codes](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/reference/error-codes.md): Lookup table for ACELIB-<AREA>-<CODE> including trigger conditions and categories.
- [Release Artifacts](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/reference/release-artifacts.md): How to obtain the API from JitPack, build the server JAR, and use the local Maven coordinate.
- [API Surface](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/reference/api-surface.md): Classification for all 143 public types into Supported, SPI, and Internal.
- [Runtime Compatibility Matrix](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/docs/reference/runtime-compatibility-matrix.json): Machine-readable version matrix (JSON) with platform, status (SUPPORTED / VERIFIED-BETA / UNVERIFIED), and evidence for each verified runtime.

## Changelog
- [Changelog](https://github.com/smile-minecraft/AceLib/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history and upgrade notes for all releases.

## AI agent integration notes
- Get the API through Bukkit ServicesManager via `getRegistration(AceLibApi.AceLibProvider.class)`, call `provider.api()`, and check `api.isReady()` before using any service. After an internal reload, re-acquire via `provider.api()` on the same provider; after disable, the ServicesManager registration is removed (re-query returns null) and any retained provider becomes a shutdown (not-ready) facade (see provider-lifecycle.md and the Getting the API section in README).
- Only depend on types marked Supported in api-surface.md. SPI types may be implemented by extension authors under their documented contract; do not depend on Internal types.
- On Folia, dispatch player, entity, block, and inventory work through SafeScheduler or SafeExecutor and validate with ContextInspector to respect region threading (see scheduler.md and context.md).
- When you see `ACELIB-<AREA>-<CODE>` in logs, look it up in error-codes.md for its module, meaning, and trigger condition.
